meta.type: WordPress child theme of hex-wp-theme-template (Hexnity WP AI Theme)
meta.purpose: Child theme that inherits all templates from its parent via WordPress's normal template hierarchy, and owns the theme-options.css data file the parent's Theme Options admin page writes to. Does NOT own a Tailwind build of its own (reversed 2026-08-29, see action-map.json) — the admin-configurable design-system CSS build lives and compiles in the parent theme only; this child theme keeps a reference-only, unbuilt copy of site-theme.css for a child developer to read/adapt.
meta.boundary: All work is strictly confined to this child theme's own directory — do not reach into the parent theme's directory. See claude.md and GUIDELINES.md.

docs.claude.md: Session entry point — process rules for working in this directory (read GUIDELINES.md next, bootstrap/maintain this project.json + action-map.json, versioning, folder boundary).
docs.GUIDELINES.md: The compatibility contract with the parent theme — required style.css header, enqueue architecture, theme-options.css format rules (always px, derived/reserved keys, custom-token auto-detection), why not to redefine the parent's former class names now owned here, independent-updater isolation, versioning, folder boundary.

structure.style.css: Theme header (Template: hex-wp-theme-template) + a short comment pointing to the real styling location (the parent theme). Intentionally near-empty otherwise.
structure.functions.php: Enqueues only this theme's own plain style.css (get_stylesheet_uri()), dependent on the parent's hex-tailwind handle for correct load order. No Tailwind build of its own. Loads style.css a second time on purpose (the parent's own 'hex-style' handle already loads it once, early); do not deregister 'hex-style' from here -- confirmed live to break hex-animate/hex-tailwind, which both declare it as a dependency. See ../hex-wp-theme-template/knoladge/child-theme-css-token-architecture.md.
structure.assets/css/src/site-theme.css: REFERENCE COPY ONLY, not built or enqueued from this theme (reversed 2026-08-29 — see GUIDELINES.md §4). The live version of this file is the parent theme's own assets/css/src/site-theme.css, compiled by the parent's own npm build. This copy is kept only as an editable starting point for a child-theme developer; edits here have no effect on the live site unless copied into the parent and rebuilt there.
structure.theme-options.css: The live design-token DATA file — a `:root { --hex-key: value; }` block, fully regenerated by the parent theme's Theme Options admin page on every save (hex_build_style_tokens_css() there). Unaffected by the site-theme.css reversal — always lived here and still does.

testing.status: No automated tests in this theme yet — it has no PHP logic beyond a single enqueue function (hexnity_wp_child_enqueue_assets()) and no PHPUnit/Composer setup. If real logic is added here later, follow the parent theme's WP_Mock-based pattern (see ../hex-wp-theme-template/tests/).
